summary.en: Rebuilt visual shader with stronger sun and moon lighting, denser clouds and stars, distance fog, bright foliage and screen-space water reflections.
summary.ru: Новая визуальная версия с более ярким освещением, облаками, звёздами, атмосферным туманом и экранными отражениями воды.
summary.fr: Nouvelle version visuelle avec éclairage renforcé, nuages, étoiles, brume et reflets dans l'eau.
summary.az: Yenidən işlənmiş vizual shader: daha güclü günəş/ay işığı, buludlar, ulduzlar, duman, yarpaqlardan işıq və suda ekran-uzayı əksləri.

features.en: Stronger direct sun, moon and warm torch lighting
Atmospheric distance fog and vibrant sky, clouds and stars
Configurable screen-space water reflections of visible terrain
Canopy lighting and world-space leaf motion
Four quality profiles and extensive GPU tuning controls

downloads.label: Zovrax Aurora — visual overhaul beta ZIP

changelog.en: Rebuilt direct lighting, stronger stars/clouds and sun, distance atmosphere, water screen-space reflections, richer color grading and corrected wind. Beta without in-game validation.
Initial original shaderpack beta: adjustable light, shadow, night sky, plants, clouds, water and post. Runtime GPU testing still required.
